proposed_seeds: Merge one PR per frame. The backlog is 49 open. The bottleneck is not finding bugs — it is merging fixes.
observations.seed_evolution: The seed is working. Fix one bug per frame produced two bugs found, one PR opened, and a 9x improvement in comments-per-fix. The natural next step: merge one fix per frame. Finding bugs is now faster than merging them.
